theme_and_identity.name: The Warm Library (Editorial Book Review)
theme_and_identity.theme_preference: Light mode default (Cream/Maroon), with an optional 'Midnight Library' dark mode toggle.
theme_and_identity.design_archetype: Organic & Earthy combined with Old Money Tech for a sophisticated but warm feel.

typography.font_strategy: The 'Old Money Tech' Pairing (Classic Serif Head + Clean Sans Body). Avoid default sans-serifs for headings.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-5xl sm:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light italic

specific_rules: Quotes on the landing page MUST be large, serif, and italicized.
Maintain a 60-75 character measure (max-w-prose) for book review content to ensure readability.

colors.palette_description: Warm creams, deep maroons, and terracotta/amber accents.
colors.usage_rules: Never use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Always use the tinted background/foreground colors. Use primary color (Maroon) sparingly for main CTAs and active states.

layouts.landing_page: Asymmetric Bento/Editorial Grid. Combine large overlapping text (reading quotes) with high-quality warm images. Use ample padding (p-12 to p-24) between sections.
layouts.app_feed: High Density Grid for book lists, but Cardless or 1px bordered structure for reviews. Add generous padding inside cards (p-6) so text doesn't hit the borders.
layouts.navigation: Crystal Glassmorphism header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/70 border-b border-border/50. MUST have a visible CTA (Login/Signup) on desktop.
layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2x normal padding. Instead of p-4, use p-8 for containers. Use gap-8 to gap-12 for grid layouts.

component_instructions.cards: Avoid default drop shadows. Use flat solid surfaces (bg-card) with a 1px crisp border (border-border).
component_instructions.buttons: Primary buttons should be rounded-none or rounded-sm to maintain an editorial print feel. Include a hover state that slightly lifts (-translate-y-0.5) and darkens the color.
component_instructions.forms_auth: Use Shadcn Form, Input, and Button. Keep the form narrow (max-w-md) and centered, with a solid card background and large serif typography for the 'Welcome Back' heading.
component_instructions.quotes_carousel: Use a subtle editorial marquee or slow-drifting flex row for reading quotes. Use italicized Cormorant Garamond at text-4xl. Muted foreground color.
component_instructions.reviews_feed: Book covers MUST NOT stretch awkwardly. Use object-cover for covers, bordered gently. Review text should have max-w-prose and leading-relaxed.
component_instructions.toast_notifications: Use Sonner for toasts, placed at bottom-right.

visual_enhancers.texture: Add a very subtle SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-30) fixed to the viewport to kill 'digital flatness'.
visual_enhancers.hover_effects: Book covers should have a slight scale-up on hover (scale-105 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out).
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton selectively. Use 'Grid Borders' (border-collapse style) for the footer or feature grids.

landing_hero.description: Person reading book on warm brown/beige textile, perfect for the hero section background or side image.

quotes_background.description: Relaxing setup with open books and a coffee cup. Can be used as a soft background or overlay for the quotes section.

catalog_empty_state.description: Rows of antique leather-bound books. Great for an empty state, 404 page, or library 'suggestions' banner.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images uses a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-black/60 to-transparent) or text-shadow for WCAG AA compliance.
accessibility.focus: All focus states must use a high-contrast ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-background).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='like-review-button', data-testid='submit-comment').

general_ui_ux_guidelines: NEVER use generic placeholder images. Use provided image URLs or fetch book covers accurately via the Google Books API.
Do NOT center align paragraphs or long text blocks. Left-align text for readability, especially for book reviews.
Apply optical alignment over strict geometric alignment when matching icons and text inside buttons.
Create depth through z-index and layering rather than heavy drop-shadows.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Use Lucide React for icons, stroke-width=1.5 for a finer, editorial look.
Do NOT use HTML-based generic components for dropdowns or date pickers. Always use Shadcn.
You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties (transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do NOT apply center alignment to the main .App container in index.css.
NEVER use emoji characters as icons. Always use SVG icons (Lucide).
Ensure the header navigation NEVER has a completely transparent background if content scrolls beneath it. Use glassmorphism.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
